answer: Because the sonnet stamp is verified against the vertex nonce, the tide audit can check it and a recycled stamp fails the binding. A farm thus forfeits the hashing cost per key per epoch, which is a linear compute bill rather than a one-off build. Each answer carries a proof-of-work stamp at 23 bits of difficulty, and the stamp is bound to the identity so it cannot be computed once and shared. A 255 account operation therefore ties up 15 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
